findings.text: follow-on: the brief and plan §14 require every added test to fail with its mechanism removed, and the single recorded negative control (negative-control.log, 3 failed, EXIT=1) exercises only the MERGED/CLOSED-to-None branch, so test_open_request_protects_its_members (:60), test_unreadable_state_protects_with_evidence (:105), test_recorded_number_without_url_protects (:122) and test_malformed_url_protects (:148) are not shown red against their own mechanism; each is falsifiable by inspection (a None return on the open branch, an unprotected path, or an uncaught parse error would redden; the critical regression is controlled), and the brief's own working rules ('Show that once') relax the strict reading, so this is an evidence-completeness gap rather than a live defect.

follow-on: plan §14's done-when asks for 'a read-only dry run of the boundary family plans its 17 members, with no refusal', but the fragment records only the protected-member count through recommended_name_protections (1 before, 0 after) and the 'before' value is attributed there to a coordinator baseline rather than measured by this node's live-check.log (which shows only protected_count: 0), so the end-to-end planning outcome the plan names is not demonstrated; the brief narrowed the live check to the count and this node was dispatched against the brief, so the gap belongs to the brief/plan divergence and the §3 apply node is where the dry-run evidence is now expected.
